title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ja'seem Reed elevated from Panthers practice squad
items.desc: The Panthers elevated WR Ja'Seem Reed from the practice squad.
items.impact: This move puts into question the status of WR Jalen Coker, who remains listed as questionable.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Xavier Legette (knee) placed on IR
items.desc: The Panthers placed WR Xavier Legette on injured reserve.
items.impact: Legette was already ruled out for Week 4. He remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jadarian Price (chest) placed on IR
items.desc: The Seahawks placed RB Jadarian Price on injured reserve.
items.impact: Price aggravated a chest injury during Wednesday's practice. He will now miss at least four games. Emanuel Wilson and George Holani will lead the backfield with Zach Charbonnet returning as early as next week.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Keenan Allen (groin) out for Week 4
items.desc: Keenan Allen (groin) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Commanders.
items.impact: Allen has been listed as questionable on Friday, but the veteran will indeed sit out Sunday's game. With both Allen and Alec Pierce out of action, the Colts are very thin at wide receiver. Look for Josh Downs and tight end Tyler Warren to be heavily targeted by QB Daniel Jones. Veterans Laquon Treadwell and Darius Slayton could be in the mix as well.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Justin Jefferson (ankle) aiming for Week 5 return
items.desc: Justin Jefferson (ankle) optimistic about returning in Week 5.
items.impact: Jefferson has already been ruled out for Week 4, but the Vikings are planning to try to get him back on the field for Week 5's matchup with the Saints. Jefferson is still rehabbing his injured ankle this weekend and hopes to return to the practice field next week.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Terry McLaurin (hamstring) not expected to play Sunday
items.desc: Terry McLaurin (hamstring) is likely to sit out Sunday's game against the Colts.
items.impact: McLaurin was listed as questionable on Friday, but the strong belief is that the Commanders will be without their No. 1 receiver on Sunday. Veteran Stefon Diggs and rookie Antonio Williams should see the highest snap shares among Washington wide receivers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Aaron Donald dealing with 'mild' back injury
items.desc: Aaron Donald is reportedly dealing with a "mild" back injury.
items.impact: Donald can be considered as week-to-week for now.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyson Bagent expected to start in Week 4 for Bears
items.desc: QB Tyson Bagent is expected to start for the Bears in Week 4 against the Jets.
items.impact: It is a bit surprising following a big performance for Case Keenum last week. Bagent took the majority of first-team reps this week. The announcement should be made official this weekend.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Marvin Mims Jr. (foot) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Marvin Mims Jr. is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the 49ers.
items.impact: Mims remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: J.K. Dobbins (hip) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: J.K. Dobbins is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the 49ers.
items.impact: Dobbins will remain a touchdown dependent low-end RB2 play for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaylen Waddle (foot) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Jaylen Waddle is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the 49ers.
items.impact: Waddle was seen in a walking boot after last Sunday's win. He will be a WR2 play for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joey Porter Jr. off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Joey Porter Jr. is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Texans.
items.impact: Porter is officially good to go to make his season debut immediately after getting traded to Dallas.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Terrell Jennings works out for Steelers
items.desc: Free agent RB Terrell Jennings worked out for the Steelers on Friday.
items.impact: Jennings would add depth in the backfield for Pittsburgh.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dre Greenlaw (quad) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Dre Greenlaw is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Broncos.
items.impact: Greenlaw's status will need to be monitored closer to kickoff on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mykel Williams (knee) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Mykel Williams has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Broncos.
items.impact: Williams remains without a clear timetable to return.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trent Williams (neck) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Trent Williams is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Broncos.
items.impact: Williams is officially good to go after leaving last week's game early.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Sweat (groin) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Josh Sweat is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Giants.
items.impact: Sweat was downgraded to a limited practice on Friday. His status will need to be monitored closer to kickoff.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dalvin Tomlinson (hamstring) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Dalvin Tomlinson has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Tomlinson will be sidelined with a hamstring injury.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Julian Love (calf) available to play Sunday
items.desc: Julian Love (calf) will be available to play in Sunday's game against the Los Angeles Chargers.
items.impact: Love should be good to go for Sunday's game, which was to be expected after he was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Friday. Seattle's defense will be pretty healthy this week and should continue to perform as one of the NFL's best units in a matchup against the Chargers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Zach Charbonnet (knee) won't play Sunday
items.desc: Zach Charbonnet (knee) won't play in Sunday's game against the Los Angeles Chargers.
items.impact: The veteran was able to practice twice this week, but that's not enough to give the team the confidence they need to play him this week, so he will remain out against the Chargers. Fantasy managers should expect Charbonnet to be back in the lineup sometime within the next few weeks, however, which will mean less work for Emmanuel Wilson and Jadarian Price (chest) moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: George Holani (rib) good to go for Sunday
items.desc: George Holani (rib) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Los Angeles Chargers.
items.impact: Holani's rib injury isn't serious at this point and won't prevent him from playing in Week 4. He will continue to split the backfield with Emmanuel Wilson now that rookie Jadarian Price (chest) has been ruled out for this matchup against the Chargers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Nick Emmanwori (ankle) will play Sunday
items.desc: Nick Emmanwori (ankle) will play in Sunday's game against the Los Angeles Chargers.
items.impact: Emmanwori will be available to play on Sunday, which was to be expected after he practiced in a full capacity all week. He will continue to be a key contributor for this elite defense moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kayode Awosika (leg) unavailable for Sunday
items.desc: Kayode Awosika (leg) will be unavailable to play in Sunday's game against the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: The Chargers will be down a starting lineman on Sunday, with Awosika set to be sidelined for another game due to a leg injury of some kind. Their offensive line seems likely to struggle against a very tough Seahawks' defense this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Trey Lance (groin) questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Trey Lance (groin) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: Lance is officially questionable for Sunday's game due to a groin issue that he's battling with. He's still the QB2 behind Justin Herbert, however, so his absence wouldn't have much of an impact for fantasy purposes.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Derwin James Jr. (hamstring) listed questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Derwin James Jr. (hamstring) is listed questionable for Sunday's game against the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: Los Angeles' star safety may not be available to play on Sunday. James is currently dealing with a hamstring injury and is considered questionable as a result. Their secondary will be much weaker than usual if he's unable to suit up against the reigning Super Bowl champions in Week 4.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Keaton Mitchell (ankle) without injury designation for Sunday
items.desc: Keaton Mitchell (ankle) is without an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: The veteran is going to be good to go on Sunday, despite being listed on the injury report throughout the week due to an ankle issue. He will continue to play second fiddle behind Omarion Hampton on this offense, although his exact snap share remains worth keeping an eye on this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brenen Thompson (quad) unavailable for Sunday
items.desc: Brenen Thompson (quad) will be unavailable for Sunday's game against the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: Thompson is not going to be available to play on Sunday due to the quad injury that he's dealing with. The Chargers are set to be thinner than usual at the wideout position this week, especially if Ladd McConkey (foot) is also ruled out for this matchup against Seattle.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Charlie Kolar (arm) won't play Sunday
items.desc: Charlie Kolar (arm) won't play in Sunday's game against the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: The veteran is going to be sidelined for another game on Sunday as he continues to recover from an arm injury. Fantasy managers should continue to expect increased snaps for Oronde Gadsden II until Kolar is back in the lineup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ladd McConkey (foot) questionable to play Sunday
items.desc: Ladd McConkey (foot) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: McConkey is uncertain to play in Week 4. He is dealing with a foot injury of some kind and was limited at practice on Friday because of it, but the team will wait until closer to game time before making an official determination about his status. Fantasy managers should look for Oronde Gadsden II to see more work if McConkey is unavailable to play this week, though it would be hard to start any Chargers in this tough matchup against Seattle if that's the case.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jaylen Watson (shoulder) sidelined for Sunday
items.desc: Jaylen Watson (shoulder) will be sidelined for Sunday's game against the Philadelphia Eagles.
items.impact: Watson is not going to be available to play on Sunday, which isn't great news for Los Angeles' secondary. Still, they have a favorable matchup this week, facing a Philadelphia offense who won't have Devonta Smith (hamstring) or Dallas Goedert (knee) available to play.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kamren Kinchens (hamstring) will play Sunday
items.desc: Kamren Kinchens (hamstring) will play in Sunday's game against the Philadelphia Eagles.
items.impact: Los Angeles' secondary will be getting a nice boost in Week 4 with Kinchens making his return to the lineup. He's over his hamstring injury at this point and should be good to go moving forward.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Terrance Ferguson (ankle) placed on IR
items.desc: The Rams placed TE Terrance Ferguson on injured reserve.
items.impact: Ferguson went down with the injury last Sunday. He will now miss at least the next four games.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyjae Spears (ankle) questionable to play Sunday
items.desc: Tyjae Spears (ankle) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Baltimore Ravens.
items.impact: Spears is uncertain to play on Sunday. He's still managing an ankle injury, so the team officially has him listed as questionable to play right now. Tony Pollard will be the team's clear-cut RB1 if Spears if ruled out ahead of game time against the Ravens.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tony Pollard (foot) good to go for Sunday
items.desc: Tony Pollard (foot) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Baltimore Ravens.
items.impact: Pollard is going to be good to go for Sunday's game, despite being on the injury report all week due to a foot issue. He will see the vast majority of touches in this backfield if Tyjae Spears (ankle) is sidelined for this matchup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ashton Dulin (ankle) listed questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Ashton Dulin (ankle) is listed questionable for Sunday's game against the Washington Commanders.
items.impact: Dulin was a full participant at practice on Thursday and Friday, but the team still isn't sure if he will play in Week 4 are currently have him listed as questionable to play. If he's active and Keenan Allen (groin) is not, fantasy managers should expect him to see more work than he usually does against the Commanders.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mike Evans (ribs) to be game-time decision Sunday
items.desc: 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan said Mike Evans will be a game-time decision heading into Sunday.
items.impact: Evans has been managing an injury to his ribs that he suffered last week. There is some risk that he may be limited if he is ruled active. He would be a risky WR2 play for fantasy managers this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Mo Alie-Cox (illness) cleared to play Sunday
items.desc: Mo Alie-Cox (illness) has been cleared to play for Sunday morning's game against the Washington Commanders.
items.impact: The Colts will have their veteran tight end on Sunday, as Alie-Cox has been cleared to play after missing two practices early in the week due to an illness. He remains off of the fantasy radar moving forward, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Trent Brown (illness/knee/wrist) available to play Sunday
items.desc: Trent Brown (illness/knee/wrist) will be available to play in Sunday's game against the Dallas Cowboys.
items.impact: Brown missed practice early in the week for the Texans, but he is set to play in Week 4 and should be close to full health against the Cowboys. Houston's offensive line will be close to full health if Ed Ingram (groin) is cleared to play as well.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ed Ingram (groin) questionable Thursday
items.desc: Ed Ingram (groin) will be questionable for Sunday's game against the Dallas Cowboys.
items.impact: The Texans are listing Ingram as questionable to play heading into the weekend. He's dealing with a groin injury right now, and if he's not able to play through it, that would be suboptimal for the fantasy outlook of CJ Stroud and David Montgomery in this matchup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Will Anderson Jr. (ankle) cleared to play Sunday
items.desc: Will Anderson Jr. (ankle) has been cleared to play in Sunday's game against the Dallas Cowboys.
items.impact: Anderson is going to play on Sunday, despite being limited at practice earlier in the week due to an ankle issue. That's bad news for Dak Prescott, Javonte Williams, and Dallas' entire offense ahead of their matchup in Week 4.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Nico Collins (hamstring) good to go for Sunday
items.desc: Nico Collins (hamstring) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Dallas Cowboys.
items.impact: Collins is set to make his return to the lineup on Sunday after missing the last two games due to a hamstring injury. Fantasy managers shouldn't hesitate to start him as often as he's healthy and on the field moving forward. His return will likely mean less work for Dalton Schultz and Xavier Hutchinson for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Deonte Banks (calf) cleared to play Sunday
items.desc: Deonte Banks (calf) has been cleared to play in Sunday's game against the Arizona Cardinals.
items.impact: Banks has been out for a couple of games while dealing with a calf injury, but he is over it now and will be good to go for Week 4. His return will bolster a talented New York secondary moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: John Michael Schmitz Jr. (personal) will play Sunday
items.desc: John Michael Schmitz Jr. (personal) will play in Sunday's game against the Arizona Cardinals.
items.impact: Michael Schmitz was previously dealing with a personal issue of some kind, but it won't affect his availability for Week 4 and he will play on Sunday. New York's offensive line should be at full strength with Andrew Thomas (groin) also being cleared to play.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Andrew Thomas (groin) good to go for Sunday
items.desc: Andrew Thomas (groin) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Arizona Cardinals.
items.impact: Thomas has received full clearance and is set to play in Sunday's game against the Cardinals. That's great news for New York's offense, although they still don't project to score many points in this favorable matchup against the Cardinals.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ronnie Stanley (toe) questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Ronnie Stanley (toe) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Tennessee Titans.
items.impact: Stanley was sidelined last week due to a toe issue of some kind, but he is questionable and will have a chance to make his return to the lineup in Week 4. Baltimore's offense will function much better if the veteran is back to anchor down the left tackle position moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: John Simpson (groin) without injury designation for Sunday
items.desc: John Simpson (groin) is without an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Tennessee Titans.
items.impact: The veteran seems to be fully over his groin injury, as he carries no injury designation heading into the weekend. Baltimore's offensive line will be near full strength if Ronnie Stanley (toe) is able to suit up and play against Tennessee.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chris Moore (ankle) listed questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Chris Moore (ankle) is listed questionable for Sunday's game against the Tennessee Titans.
items.impact: Moore is uncertain to play on Sunday as he continues to manage an ankle issue of some kind. Zay Flowers (hamstring) is also questionable to play, so Baltimore's offense will be much weaker if both of those guys are unable to suit up against the Titans.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Lamar Jackson (back) good to go for Sunday
items.desc: Lamar Jackson (back) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Tennessee Titans.
items.impact: Jackson was managing a back issue earlier in the week, but he carries no injury designation heading into the weekend and will be good to go against the Titans. His fantasy outlook for this game will improve a lot if Zay Flowers (hamstring) is cleared to play ahead of game time.
